title: Order Clear Ornaments and Fill Yourself
text: Order Clear Ornaments and Fill Yourself. Are you kidding me.  Don't waste your money.  They are big ornaments that had very little added.  You can get these bulbs anywhere and fill nicely.  I will end up keeping to  add my own fillers but definitely not worth buying.
